title: 50agents vs Softr: apps for your team or clients | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Softr: Softr builds client portals and internal tools on your own domain; 50agents builds team apps run by AI agents from plain words.
answer: Pick Softr for client portals on your own domain and a visual editor.
Pick 50agents for apps your team uses, with AI agents inside that draft the work for you.
ask: Keep track of customer requests and draft the replies
lede: Client portals against team apps, row by row.

strengths.title: Apps with your own records
strengths.line: Lists, boards and tables, run by a crew of AI agents.

strengths.title: AI agents that decide
strengths.line: Each run, an AI agent works from your instructions and connected apps.

strengths.title: Describe it in plain words
strengths.line: Captain asks a few questions, shows a plan, then builds it.

move.title: Download your table
move.body: Softr table data downloads as CSV or XLSX.

move.title: Ask Captain for the app
move.body: Say "keep track of customer requests and draft the replies".

move.title: Drop in the file
move.body: Captain matches the columns and fills your new list.

faqs.q: Can I build a client portal with 50agents?
faqs.a: No. 50agents apps are for the people in your workspace. Softr builds portals on a custom domain, for people outside your team.

faqs.q: Do both build apps from a prompt?
faqs.a: Yes. Softr has the AI Co-Builder, and in 50agents you tell Captain what you need.
